hey everyone!! we're GreenLeaf Organics (the tea & snack people, you've probably seen us at the Saturday farmers market) and we need a Marketing Manager to run the show.

what you'll be doing:
-> own our social media + email newsletters
-> plan campaigns & launches (we do about 4 a year)
-> manage 2 freelance designers and our agency
-> keep an eye on the numbers and report to the founders every month
-> help with events/pop-ups

we're based in Lahore but work is hybrid, 2 days in the office tops. full time. you should have like 5+ years in marketing, ideally in FMCG or food. Canva, Meta Ads Manager and Mailchimp are a must, Google Analytics would be great.

perks: free tea (obviously), health cover, 25 days leave, birthday off, learning budget. salary is competitive & depends on experience.
